name: mirage
text: Cause found for the '0 live games': that tile only counts the light lane (NFL, NCAAF, NBA, WNBA, NCAAB, NHL, MLB, using ESPN scores). Tennis runs through a different lane (the Pinnacle-fair one, which shows 'matched 2 · 2 lines'), and its games never reach the tile. So 0 is wrong for tennis. I'm changing the tile and the Live tab to count and list the tennis games too, then I'll check why those 2 matched lines place nothing.
